items.expectedFix: Add a mutual aggregate cap of at least 12 months' fees, with uncapped carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct; preferably also carve out data protection/security, fraud and IP infringement and clarify that payment obligations are not damages.
items.note: The consequential-damages exclusion is mutual and appropriately carves out fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, confidentiality, exclusivity and third-party indemnity damages, but the agreement contains no aggregate liability cap. AbbVie's direct-damages exposure is therefore uncapped.

items.expectedFix: Confirm expressly that Harpoon defends and indemnifies AbbVie and its affiliates against third-party IP infringement claims, with customary exclusions and procurement, modification, replacement or refund remedies; also limit AbbVie's indemnity to AbbVie-provided materials and AbbVie's breach of law.
items.note: Harpoon expressly defends and indemnifies AbbVie and its affiliates against third-party claims, and the patent-infringement defense clause is subject to that indemnity. However, the substantive indemnity triggers in Sections 11.1 and 11.2 are redacted, so it is impossible to confirm an express Harpoon IP indemnity or assess exclusions and the scope of AbbVie's indemnity.

The non-compete binds Harpoon and its affiliates, not AbbVie, and therefore benefits the customer side. The acquisition and change-of-control exceptions do not impose a competing-business restriction on AbbVie.

These provisions give AbbVie an exclusive option and co-exclusive or exclusive licences under Harpoon's technology. They do not require AbbVie to buy exclusively from Harpoon or refrain from procuring competing products or services.
No most-favoured-nation obligation requires AbbVie to extend Harpoon terms offered to third parties or to match third-party offers.
No employee non-solicitation or no-hire restriction binds AbbVie.

items.expectedFix: No required change. For the preferred position, shorten AbbVie's notice period to 30 days and provide any applicable pro-rata refund.
items.note: AbbVie may terminate the agreement in whole or by country for any or no reason on 90 days' written notice. This reaches the fallback standard, and Harpoon has no corresponding short-notice convenience right.
The agreement runs through the applicable option or royalty term and contains no automatic renewal or non-renewal notice trap.

items.expectedFix: Specify Delaware courts or an arbitration seat in New York, Delaware, California or London, and remove any possibility of mandatory arbitration seated in an unaccepted foreign jurisdiction.
items.note: Delaware governing law is an accepted fallback. Most disputes, however, are subject to arbitration under a fully redacted schedule, so the arbitration seat and forum cannot be confirmed as an accepted jurisdiction.

items.expectedFix: Add prompt written notice for any assignment to an affiliate or successor. Preferably also prohibit Harpoon from assigning to an AbbVie competitor without AbbVie's consent.
items.note: The clause permits AbbVie to assign without consent to an affiliate or an M&A successor and applies a reasonable-consent standard to other assignments. It substantially reaches fallback, but permitted affiliate and successor assignments do not require written notice.

The separate change-of-control regime concerns Harpoon's change of control, requires notice to AbbVie and gives AbbVie protective rights where the acquirer has a competing product. It does not give Harpoon a termination or repricing right upon AbbVie's change of control.

items.expectedFix: No change required under this rule because the joint ownership includes an unrestricted exploitation right and AbbVie does not assign its pre-existing IP or data to Harpoon.
items.note: Each party retains separately created and pre-existing IP, while jointly created IP is jointly owned. Although joint ownership is created, each party may exploit the joint IP without consent or accounting, and AbbVie separately owns regulatory documentation and product trademarks and receives broad exclusive product licences.

AbbVie's exercised licence is exclusive across the worldwide Territory and broad Field, may be sublicensed through multiple tiers to affiliates and other persons, supports affiliate performance, and is transferable to an affiliate or M&A successor. Following ordinary expiration it becomes fully paid, royalty-free and irrevocable. The limited performance and termination-reversion licences granted by AbbVie to Harpoon do not narrow AbbVie's core licence.

items.expectedFix: Specify no more than one audit per year on at least 15 days' written notice, during business hours, at Harpoon's cost unless underpayment exceeds 10% (preferably 5%), with no direct access to AbbVie systems.
items.note: Harpoon's audit is limited to relevant books and records and must use an independent nationally recognized accounting firm reasonably acceptable to AbbVie, with confidentiality restrictions. Frequency, lookback period and the underpayment threshold for shifting costs are redacted, and no visible minimum advance-notice period can be confirmed.
No liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination fee is payable by AbbVie. Upfront, milestone and royalty payments are commercial consideration rather than breach-triggered liquidated damages.

items.expectedFix: Add a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a conformance warranty lasting at least 30 days for services and 90 days for software or deliverables, and repair, replacement or refund remedies; also include compliance with law and no-malicious-code assurances where applicable.
items.note: Harpoon must use appropriately qualified personnel and comply with applicable law, but there is no express professional-and-workmanlike performance or deliverable-conformance warranty, no warranty period and no repair, replacement or refund remedy. The broad disclaimer preserves only the agreement's limited express warranties.

items.expectedFix: Require Harpoon to maintain at least USD 1 million E&O and USD 2 million cyber/privacy insurance, plus appropriate CGL and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates available on request.
items.note: Harpoon must maintain workers' compensation, employers' liability and general liability/clinical-trial insurance and provide certificates on request. The monetary limits are redacted, and the listed coverages omit professional/E&O and cyber/privacy insurance.
The agreement contains upfront, milestone and royalty consideration but no minimum purchase volume, take-or-pay obligation or shortfall penalty imposed on AbbVie.

items.expectedFix: If Harpoon holds AbbVie data or performs operational services, add at least 90 days of transition assistance, export of AbbVie data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after return.
items.note: The cited provisions provide an inventory sell-off period and an insurance tail, not Harpoon transition services. There is a mutual confidential-information return mechanism, while the detailed reversion obligations largely run from AbbVie to Harpoon and are redacted. No clear Harpoon obligation provides post-termination assistance or exports AbbVie data, although the need for a hosting-style transition regime is debatable in this development-and-licence agreement.
